thread:
support_jess: FYI — multiple customers reported intermittent 5xxs and high latency for hosted inference around 16:58-17:05 UTC. Tickets reference 502/504 from our gateway and spikes in tail latency. I collected two example request IDs: rq_8f3b2, rq_2c1a9. Customers: acme-ml (prod) and brightpay (staging).

ajay: thanks. Any deploys or config changes in the window?

ops-iris: deploys: none to inference runtime since 15:40. There was a rate-limiter config push to the edge at 16:45 (rolling, config-v13).

maria: SRE alert triggered: SLO burn on /v1/generate -- 5m burn 20% -> paging. Alert details: https://observability.redwood.prod/alerts/ALRT-9231 (paste).

sre-bot: [ALERT] slo-burn /v1/generate - 5m burn 0.20 - triggered by obs-rule gateway-timeouts-v2.

devon: can we get sampling traces for those request ids? Gateway shows upstream 502 for a lot of requests. Might be model-runner returning 504 when backend queue fills.

maria: running a quick logs query (kibana):
```
index=proxy-logs env=prod status>=500 | where timestamp >= "2026-03-15T16:55:00Z" and timestamp <= "2026-03-15T17:10:00Z" | stats count by upstream_cluster, status
```
results: upstream_cluster=model-runner-primary status=504 count=132; upstream_cluster=cache-proxy status=502 count=18; gateway timeout (downstream) 504=150.

ajay: interesting — model-runner-primary is the big one. Any CPU/GPU pressure?

ops-iris: infra metrics from prom: model-runner-primary pods show CPU stable, GPU utilization normal. However, pod restarts: 3 restarts for runner-3 in that window (oomkilled) — investigating kube events.

support_jess: customers also mentioned auth errors intermittently (401 then 502). Could be token check timing-out and causing fallback to auth-proxy which times out.

devon: check auth latency.

maria: auth-proxy logs query:
```
index=auth-logs level=error | where message like "%token lookup%" and timestamp between 16:50 and 17:05
```
found 27 entries: "token fetch timeout 2.5s" for tenant brightpay; upstream KMS latency ~2.4s. Our auth-proxy timeout is 2s -> causing auth-proxy to return 504 then gateway shows 502?

ajay: that mismatch would cause cascade. If auth-proxy is timing out, gateway might surface a 502 to callers. But we still have many pure model-runner 504s. Maybe two simultaneous issues: auth KMS latency spike + increased model-runner queuing due to burst of long-context requests.

ops-iris: traced one request: trace id trace-0a1b2c3 (link: https://traces.redwood.prod/trace/0a1b2c3) — missing spans between gateway and runner for ~30% of samples (trace gap). Looks like connection resets on upstream keepalive. Kernel logs from runner show "connection reset by peer" around same time.

devon: could be ephemeral socket exhaustion at the edge proxies when many keepalive sessions spike. Any recent change to keepalive settings in config-v13?

ops-iris: config-v13 reduced keepalive timeout from 120s -> 10s to free sockets quicker (intended). That was rolled at 16:45. If connections get recycled aggressively while large requests are in-flight, we could see resets and gaps.

maria: timeline hypothesis: rate-limiter/keepalive change -> increased churn of upstream sockets -> occasional connection resets -> model-runner sees partial requests/queue anomalies -> some pods OOM/restart -> KMS latency spike affects auth -> combined effect causes SLO burn and 5xx flood.

ajay: we should revert the keepalive change and pause the rollout. Also increase auth-proxy timeout to 5s temporarily and add more KMS client retries.

devon: agreed. I can rollback config-v13 on the edge in the next 3 minutes. Who can bump auth-proxy timeout?

maria: I can open a quick deploy: auth-proxy timeout 2s -> 6s, add retry with backoff. Patching now.

support_jess: telling customers we're investigating; ETA ~15-30m.

ops-iris: rolling back keepalive change now. Command: `edgectl rollout cancel config-v13 && edgectl promote config-v12`

(ops-iris) 16:57:10: rollback initiated.

sre-bot: [NOTIFICATION] rollback started by ops-iris for config-v13 -> v12.

maria: patch deployed for auth-proxy (timeout 6s) 16:58:05.

ajay: after rollback and patch we should watch logs and traces. Re-running kibana query for the 17:00-17:08 window.

maria: post-patch counts: model-runner 5xxs dropped from 132 -> 12 in 5m window; auth-proxy token timeouts down to 3. SLO burn falling.

devon: great. Any follow-ups? Need an RCA: correlation of edge config change, socket churn metrics, pod OOM cause (memory pressure) and KMS upstream latency. Also action items: revert keepalive default in config docs, add canary to keepalive changes, increase auth-proxy timeout in prod by default, and add instrumentation for connection resets in gateway dashboards.

ops-iris: opened incident (INC-2026-0815) and added timeline + commands executed. I'll attach kube event logs and kernel dmesg for runner-3.

support_jess: I'll follow up with customers with a short incident summary and ETA for RCA.

maria: for postmortem: please attach the following artifacts: edge config diff (v12->v13), gateway socket metrics, traces (sample set), auth-proxy logs, kube events for runner-3, prom query outputs. I'll draft the RCA.

ajay: also add a test-case to our perf suite that fuzzes keepalive churn at scale.

devon: locking this thread to track action items; if anyone finds additional anomalies (billing spikes, token TTL misconfig, unusual request sizes), post here. Good catch team. :thumbsup:
